domain: Narrative Constraint Analysis / Folk-Legal Ritual Systems
topic_summary: A grieving widower petitions an inherited, unappealable folk-legal authority (the Reed-Law) for a single, absolute-condition trial to reclaim his dead wife from a liminal marsh jurisdiction. He fails via an epistemically unresolvable doubt (he cannot verify her presence without breaking the rule that forbids verification), losing her permanently under a system whose administrator experiences the outcome as procedurally fair rather than tragic. A third figure, the woman who taught him the grief-ritual as a child, watches the entire apparatus — ritual, law, and loss — recur across generations without ever being able to soften any part of it.

key_entities: Cal Renwick (petitioner; former grief-ritual student; sole agent of the trial)
Ness (ritual-teacher; salt-panner; narrates before/after but has no procedural agency)
Warden Ossory (hereditary adjudicator of the Reed-Law; administers via inherited, unquestioned form)
Mara / the Reed-Law itself (the deceased and the jurisdictional mechanism that holds her, treated by the parish as weather rather than law)
key_tensions: Petitioner's need for verification vs. the rule's absolute prohibition on verification (the trial is structured so that the only evidence of success is also the act that guarantees failure)
Administrator's procedural fairness (equal terms applied to all, symmetry as proof of justice) vs. the terms' substantive severity (a single unappealable all-or-nothing condition with no margin)

axes.human_readable: The Unverifiable Trial (Doubt Manufactured by the Rule Itself)
axes.structural_delta: A trial's sole success condition requires the petitioner to refrain from the one act that would confirm the condition is being met, so that the psychological weight of doubt is not incidental to the trial but is structurally manufactured by its design — the rule creates the very uncertainty it then punishes.
axes.primary_observable: Ratio of trials failed via petitioner-initiated verification vs. trials that would have succeeded absent doubt; presence/absence of any evidentiary channel other than the forbidden act itself
axes.selection_reason: Highest structural distinctiveness — this is the mechanism that actually produces the narrative's climax (Cal's turn), independent of who administers it or who taught the ritual

axes.human_readable: Equal Application as Moral Alibi for Unexamined Severity
axes.structural_delta: An authority evaluates its own justice purely by internal consistency (same terms offered to everyone, in every generation, without exception) and treats that consistency as sufficient proof of fairness, thereby exempting the terms' actual severity from ever being examined as a separate question — symmetry of application substitutes for scrutiny of content.
axes.primary_observable: Adjudicator's stated criteria for 'fair' (form-matching, precedent-matching) vs. absence of any criterion referencing outcome-severity or petitioner cost; frequency of terms being reconsidered across generations (zero)
axes.selection_reason: Distinct observable (adjudicator's internal reasoning/criteria) and distinct beneficiary (the office itself, via the comfort of unexamined rhythm) from axis 1's petitioner-side mechanism; highest centrality as the node connecting rule-design to institutional self-perception

axes.human_readable: Taught Comfort as Later-Weaponized Lever (Ritual Knowledge Outrunning Its Teacher's Control)
axes.structural_delta: A grief-ritual is transmitted to a child as pure comfort, before he has grief to test it against, and the teacher has no mechanism to prevent the ritual from later being repurposed by the student as an instrumental key to a coercive system — the transmission is complete and irreversible at the moment of teaching, leaving the teacher permanently downstream of a use she never authorized and cannot soften.
axes.primary_observable: Gap between the ritual's original taught function (comfort/steadying) and its later deployed function (key/lever into the Warden's jurisdiction); teacher's stated inability to modify or withhold the ritual once it is 'complete' (whole name, exact hour, or it does nothing)
axes.selection_reason: Distinct observable (transmission fidelity/completeness) and distinct hypothesis class (rope — a coordination technology that predates and outlasts any single deployment) from both other axes; provides the generational/temporal frame the other two axes lack

axes.human_readable: Scarcity of Grants as Its Own Proof of Rightness (Rarity Mistaken for Rigor)
axes.structural_delta: An office grants trials at a rate low enough to feel exceptional (one per generation or two) and reads that rarity itself as evidence the threshold is correctly calibrated, rather than as an independent variable that could reflect either correct calibration or accumulated institutional caution having nothing to do with actual merit.
axes.primary_observable: Historical grant rate across three generations of Wardens; absence of any documented criterion distinguishing granted from refused petitions beyond 'completeness of the sung form'
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: substantially overlaps observable space with procedural_fairness_as_severity_laundering (Type A/B boundary — both examine the office's self-justifying logic); lower independent yield once axis 2 is generated

axes.human_readable: The Excluded Witness (Community Knowledge Available Only After the Fact That Matters)
axes.structural_delta: The parish, including the ritual's own teacher, is structurally barred from any access to the trial's decisive middle — only the beginning and end are witnessed by anyone but the petitioner — so that communal knowledge, memory, and even language itself (the absence of a word for this specific grief) permanently lag behind the events that most need naming.
axes.primary_observable: What information channels exist for non-petitioners (Watchmen's start/end report only); presence/absence of parish vocabulary for the specific post-failure state ('there should be another word... but there isn't')
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: real and distinct but lowest centrality; functions as atmospheric/omega material rather than a load-bearing constraint axis given the 3-axis selection

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Rarity of grants mistaken for proof of correct calibration
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Overlaps observable space with procedural_fairness_as_severity_laundering; both interrogate the office's self-referential justification logic

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Parish/teacher permanently excluded from the decisive middle of the event; language itself lags the grief
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Lowest centrality; atmospheric rather than load-bearing; strong candidate for omega treatment

omegas.description: The Reed-Law's terms are never traced to an originating rationale — 'no margin, no fallback' is inherited whole, unquestioned, like 'the shape of a doorway.' Whether the rule was ever deliberately designed to be this severe, or drifted into severity through pure repetition, remains structurally undecidable from the text.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) — mountain vs. piton ambiguity in Ossory's III/VI sections

omegas.description: Ness possesses ritual knowledge (the Keening) that clearly has instrumental power over the jurisdiction, but she is never shown as a petitioner or reformer herself. Whether her exclusion is chosen, structural, or simply unexplored is left open, and bears on whether ritual_transmission_as_double_edged_inheritance is a rope or a tangled_rope.
omegas.source: Beneficiary Scan — Ness benefits from nothing in this arrangement yet sustains it across generations

omegas.description: The keeping-salt is explicitly stated to do nothing against the grief that matters ('cure the manageable' only), yet is transmitted anyway as an act of care. Whether this constitutes a third minor axis (comfort objects as placebo scaffolding) or is fully subsumed by ritual_transmission_as_double_edged_inheritance is unresolved.
omegas.source: F43 check — possible phantom independence between salt-as-object and Keening-as-ritual

fracture_scan.notes: No fractures triggering orchestrator pause. Six candidate axes were identified via multi-lens scan (ritual/linguistic anthropology lens, legal-procedural lens, folk-institutional lens); three survived independence testing with distinct observables and non-overlapping beneficiary/victim structures. The two deferred axes (self-validating scarcity, excluded witness) were dropped for observable-overlap and low centrality respectively, not for lack of textual support — both are well-evidenced and routed to omegas for essayist use.
